page.overview:
Who is Brothers Fleissman?

Few along the Kislev border had many kind words to say about the Fleissman Brothers. Accomplished Bright Wizards, they chiefly used their talents for extortion, rather than more honourable pursuits. More than one merchant's warehouse "inexplicably" burnt down after its owner refused to make a gift of gold crowns to the brothers. Nevertheless, the Fleissmans were nothing if not staunch patriots and stood the line at Alderfen.

In the videogame Vermintide, the Brothers Fleissman are identified as Johann and his younger brother Erich, both of whom having been banished from the Bright Order for stealing magical swords from their fellow colleagues.
